uncited: *   **Input:** A set of 3D Gaussians defined by position, covariance (or conic parameters), opacity, and spherical harmonics coefficients.
**Gaussian Attributes:** Standard 3DGS attributes.
**Macro-tile List:** A contiguous array of depth keys and Gaussian IDs, segmented by macro-tile.
**Work Queue:** A shared atomic queue for render tiles within a macro-tile.
**Scheduling Buffer:** Per-worker buffer to absorb variability in visible Gaussian counts.
**Partial Blending Buffer:** Per-batch buffer storing intermediate alpha/composite results.
Gaussians are processed in partitioning batches of $P$ Gaussians.
For each Gaussian, a conservative per-row ellipse-contour scan determines overlap with macro-tiles.
Overlapping Gaussians are assigned to the corresponding macro-tile's range in the output list.
A fully asynchronous on-device segmented sort is performed on the macro-tile lists.
This runs as a cascade of tier-classified per-segment block sorts.
The result is a depth-sorted list of Gaussians for each macro-tile.
Each macro-tile's sorted Gaussian list is split into fixed-size batches of $B=1,024$ Gaussians.
Each pair $(\text{Macro-tile}, \text{Batch})$ becomes an independent processing unit.
Within each processing unit, worker groups dynamically claim active render tiles from a shared tile work queue.
For each claimed render tile, the worker group determines per-tile visibility masks inline.
Each worker group rasterizes its assigned $8 \times 8$ pixel tile via front-to-back alpha blending.
*   **Oversized Segments:** During sorting, segments may vary greatly in size.
*   **Pair Count Reduction:** At 1080p, mean tile-Gaussian pair counts drop from 10.1M (gsplat) to 1.51M (HiGS), an 85% reduction.
*   **Strengths:** Eliminates the rasterizer tail effect, retains exact alpha compositing, works on commodity GPUs, and significantly reduces pair counts.
*   **Limitations:** Requires preallocation of buffers which may increase peak memory usage compared to dynamic allocation approaches.
The complexity of the segmented sort and hierarchical dispatch is higher than standard 3DGS.
